final: WITH item_town AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city AS town, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), town_averages AS (SELECT town, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM item_town GROUP BY town) SELECT town, avg_price, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town_averages) AS ratio_above_town_average FROM town_averages WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town_averages)
